integrity: Complete proof and a standard-library exact exhaustive verifier are embedded; finite checks are not substituted for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact for iid atomless rectangular matrices only. Ties, dependence, and independently sampled player payoffs are excluded. Historical novelty remains provisional; Baldi--Rinott--Stein (1989) already established square-model first two moments and a CLT.
title: An exact hypergeometric law for mutual row–column maxima
